text: {"colonist": "Lidia 'Stench' Schmitt", "line": "[N], I'm hauling these eighteen steel pieces to the stockpile just like I stashed my fifty-six beams before.", "reported": "Stench said she was hauling those eighteen steel pieces to the stockpile just like she had stashed her fifty-six beams before.", "reply": "Just make sure you don't burn anything this time, Lidia."}
